verses.en: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
verses.sm: Ioane 7:53-8:11, ua le o maua lea vaega

verses.en: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.
verses.sm: i nisi ata o le F. Fou i le gagana Eleni, a ua maua i nisi ata i le faai‘uga o le Evagelia a Ioane pofo ie sosoo ai ma le Luka 21:38.

verses.en: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,
verses.sm: Ua ta'ita'iina mai e le au tusiupu ma le au faresaio le fafine na maua ina o mulilua; ua tuuina o la ei latou i totonu;

verses.en: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.
verses.sm: ua faapea mai i latou ia te ia, “Le aʻoaʻo e, ua maua lenei fafine ina o mulilua ua mautinoa lava.

verses.en: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?
verses.sm: Ua poloai Mose ia te i tatou i le tulafono ia fetogi i maa o e faapea; a o oe, pe se a se mea e te fetalai mai i ai?”

verses.en: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.
verses.sm: Ua latou faapea mai e tofotofo ia te ia, ina ia :maua e i latou se mea e molia ai o ia; a ua punou Iesu, ma tusi i lona tamatamai lima i le eleele.

verses.en: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
verses.sm: A ua latou fesili atu pea lava ia te ia; ona toe nofo lea o ia i luga, ma faapea atu ia te i latou, “O so outou e leai sana agasala, ia lua‘i togi se maa ia te ia.”

verses.en: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.
verses.sm: Ona toe punou lea o ia, ma tusi i le eleele.

verses.en: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.
verses.sm: Ua latou faalogo i ai, ona taitoatasi lea o i latou ma alu i fafo, e afua mai i toeaina. Ua tuua na o Iesu lava, ma le fafine o loo tu i totonu.

verses.en: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?
verses.sm: Ua toe nofo i luga Iesu, ua silafia ua leai se tagata, ua na o le fafine lava, ona fetalai atu lea o ia ia te ia, “Funa e, o ifea ea i latou? Ua le faasala mai ea se tasi ia te oe?”

verses.en: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
verses.sm: la fai mai o ia, “Le Alii e, e leai lava se tasi.” Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia te ia, “Ou te le faasala foi ia te oe; alu ia oe, “aua e te toe agasala.”

verses.en: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
verses.sm: One to: fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia te i latou, “O aʻu nei o le malamalama o le lalolagi; o lē mulimuli mai ia te au, e le savali o ia i le pouliuli, a e ia te ia le malamalama o le ola.”

verses.en: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o le au faresaio ia te ia, “Ua e moli mau oe ja te oe; e le faamaoni lau mau.”

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.
verses.sm: Ua tali atu lesu ia te i latou, “E ui lava ina ou molimau aʻu ia te au, a e faamaoni lava laʻu mau; aua ua ou iloa le mea na ou sau ai, ma le mea ou te alu i ai; a ua outou le iloa le mea na ou sau ai, ma le mea ou te alu i ai.

verses.en: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
verses.sm: Tou te faamasino faaletino; ou te le faamasino i se tasi.

verses.en: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
verses.sm: A e afai ou te faamasino, e moni laʻu faamasinoga; auá ou te le toatasi lava aʻu, peitai o i maua ma le Tama ua awna mai aʻu.

verses.en: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.
verses.sm: Ua tusia i la outou tulafono, E moni le mau a tagata e toalua.

verses.en: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.
verses.sm: O aʻu nei lë molimau ia te au, o loo molimau foi ia te au le Tamá ua auina mai au.”

verses.en: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.
verses.sm: Ona latou fai mai lea ia te ia, “O ifea lou Tama?” Ua tali atu Iesu, “E lei iloa e outou o a‘u, po o lo'u Tamá; ana iloa e outou o aʻu, po ua iloa foi e outou o loʻu Tama.”

verses.en: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu Iesu i nei upu i le mea e teu ai oloa, ina o aʻoaʻo atu ia i le malumalu; a e lei puea o ia e se tasi, aua ua le 00 i ona po.

verses.en: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.
verses.sm: Ona toe fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia te i latou, “Ou te alu ese, ona outou saili lea ia te au, a e oti outou i a outou agasala; e le mafai e outou ona 6 i le mea ou te alu i ai.”

verses.en: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.
verses.sm: Ona fai ane lea o lutaia, “E fasioti ea o ia ia te ia ina ua faapea mai o ia, E le mafai e outou ona 6 i le mea ou te alu i ai?”

verses.en: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu foi o ia ia te i latou, “O outou o lalo nei, o aʻu mai lugā; o outou e 6 le lalolagi nei, e le so le lalolagi aʻu.

verses.en: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.
verses.sm: O lea ua ou fai atu ai ia te outou, E oti outou i a outou aga- “E moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia sala; aua a outou le talitonu, o au lenei o ia, ona oti lea o outou i a outou agasala.”

verses.en: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai ai lea o i latou ia te ia,” O ai ea oe?” Ona fetalai atu lea o lesu ia te i latou, “O aʻu le ua ou fai atu ai ia te outou talu le amataga.

verses.en: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.
verses.sm: E tele mea ua ia te au e tautala atu ai ma faamasino ai ia te outou; a o ia ua awna mai au, e moni lava o ia. O mea ua ou faalogo ai ia te ia, o mea ia Ou te fai atu ai i le lalolagi.”

verses.en: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
verses.sm: E lei iloa e i latou ua ia fetalai ia te i latou i le Tama.

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia te i latou, “Pe a siitia i luga e outou le Atalii o le tagata, ona iloa lea e outou o aʻu lenei o ia; ou te le fai fua foi se mea, a e peitai, faapei ona aʻoaʻo mai e loʻu Tata ia te au, O mea ia Ou te tautala atu ai.

verses.en: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.
verses.sm: O ia foi ua auina mai aʻu o loo ia te au ia; e le tuua aʻu e toatasi e le Tama, aua ou te faia pea lava o mea e lelei ia te ia.”

verses.en: As he spake these words, many believed on him.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu ia i nei mea, ona toatele ai lea o e na faatuatua ia te ia.

verses.en: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia Iutaia, e ua faatuatua ia te ia, “Afai tou te tumau pea i laʻu mataupu, o oʻu soo moni outou.

verses.en: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
verses.sm: E iloa foi e outou le mea moni, e tuu sa‘oloto foi outou e le upu moni.”

verses.en: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o i latou ia te ia, “O i matou nei o le fanau a Aperaamo, e lei fai lava i matou ma pologa o se tasi;

verses.en: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.
verses.sm: pe faapefea ona e fai mai, E tuu sa'oloto outou?” te outou, o sé faia le agasala, o le pologa lea i le agasala.

verses.en: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.
verses.sm: O le pologa foi, e lè tumau pea ia i le aiga; a o le atalii, e tumau pea lava ia.

verses.en: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
verses.sm: O lenei, pe a tuu sa'oloto outou e le Atalii, ona sa‘oloto faamaoni ai lea o outou.

verses.en: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.
verses.sm: Ua ou iloa o le fanau outou a Aperaamo; a ua outou fia fasioti ia te au, aua ua le ofi laʻu upu i totonu ia te outou.

verses.en: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.
verses.sm: O aʻu nei ou te tautala i mea ua ou iloa i loʻu Tama; o outou foi tou te faia mea ua outou iloa mai lo outou rata.”

verses.en: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o i latou ia te ia, “O Aperaamo lo matou tama.” Ua fetalai atu Iesu ia te i latou, “Afai o le fanau outou a Aperaamo, po ua faia e outou o le amio a Aperaamo.

verses.en: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.
verses.sm: Á ua outou fia fasioti ia te au le tagata ua tautala atu ia te outou i le upu moni, sa ou faalogo ai mai le Atua; e lei faia lea e Aperaamo.

verses.en: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.
verses.sm: Ua faia lava e outou amio a lo outou tama.” Ona faapea mai lea o i latou ia te ia, “E le ni tama toifale i matou; e tasi lo matou Tama, o le Atua lea.”

verses.en: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o lesu la te i latou, “Afai o lo outou Tama le Atua, po ua outou alofa mai ia te au, aua ua ou sau mai le Atua, ma ou sau iinei; aua foi ou te lei sau fua, a o ia lava ua auina mai aʻu.

verses.en: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.
verses.sm: Se a le mea e le lagona ai e outou laʻu nei upu? Aua tou te le mafaia ona faalogo i lau mataupu.

verses.en: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
verses.sm: O outou nai lo outou tama le tiapolo, tou te fia faia foi mea e tu34 Ua tali atu Iesu ia te i latou, ‘inanau i ai lo outou tamā. O le fasioti tagata ia talu le amataga, e le tu lava ia i le upu moni, aua e le o i totonu lava ia te ia le upu moni; a tautalaia i le tala pepelo, o lana lava lea e tautala a‘i, ana o le pepelo ia, ma le tama o le pepelo.

verses.en: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.
verses.sm: Ao a‘u nei, tou te le talitonu mai ia te au, aua ou te fai atu le upu moni.

verses.en: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?
verses.sm: O ai ea so outou na te faailoa mai sa'u agasala? Afai foi ou te tautala i le rnea moni, pe se a le mea tou te le talitonu mai ai ia te au?

verses.en: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.
verses.sm: O le mai le Atua, e faalogo ia i afioga a le Atua; o le mea lea tou te le faalogo ai, aua e le mai le Atua outou.”

verses.en: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o lutaia ia te ia, “E le ua tonu ca la matou upu, “O le Samaria oe, o loo ia te oe foi le temoni?”

verses.en: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.
verses.sm: Ua tali atu Iesu, “E le ia te au le temoni; a ou te ava lava aʻu i loʻu Tama; tou te le ava mai foi ia te au.

verses.en: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
verses.sm: So Qu te le saili foi i so‘u viiga; o le tasi o loo saili, o loo faamasino foi.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou; ai se tausi i laʻu upu, e le iloa e ia le oti, e oo i le faavavau.”

verses.en: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o Iutaia ia te ia, “O lenei ua matou iloa ua ia te oe le temon:; ua oti Aperaamo ma le au perofeta, a ua e fai mai oe, Ai se tausi i laʻu upu e le oo le oti ia te ia e 00 i le faavavau.

verses.en: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?
verses.sm: Ua sili ea oe i lo matou tama o Aperaamo, ua oti o ia? O le au perofeta, ua ou foii latou! Poo ai ea oe e ia fai fua lava oe ia te 0e?”

verses.en: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:
verses.sm: Ua tali atu Iesu, “Afai ou te vivii aʻu ia te au, e le aoga. laʻu viiga; o loʻu Tama o ia na te yua mai aʻu, ua outou fai mai, o lo outou Atua lea.

verses.en: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.
verses.sm: E lei iloa foi o ia e outou, a ua ou iloa lava o ia; afai foi ou te fai atu, ua ou le iloa lava o ia, ona avea lea o a'u O le pepelo, e pei o outou; peitai ua ou iloa lava o ia, ou te tausi foi i lana afioga.

verses.en: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.
verses.sm: O Aperaamo lo outou tamá, na matua fiafia o ia ina a iloa e ia lo'u nei aso, na ia iloa foi, ma olioli ai.”

verses.en: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
verses.sm: Ona faapea mai lea o Iutaia ia te ia, “E lei co i le limagafulu o ou tausaga, po ua e iloa ea Aperaamo?”

verses.en: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
verses.sm: Ua faapea mai Iesu ia te i latou, “E moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, O au o lē ola, a o leʻi ola mai Aperaamo.”

verses.en: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
verses.sm: Ona latou fetagofi lea i maa e fetogi ia te ia. Ona lafi lea o Iesu, ua ulufafo i le malumalu. O le faapupulaina o mata o le tauaso
